normalization.local_and_kl: 100 * (1 - sum(calibrated error) / sum(matched no-imatrix control error))
normalization.pooling: Equal representation of three domains and three calibrations; sum errors before ratio. Within a domain, tensors are weighted by control error.
normalization.benchmark: 100 * (calibrated score - control score) / control score, then arithmetic mean across calibrations; not percent of source-score gap recovered.
normalization.benchmark_grouped_bars_06_to_09: Calibrated score (%) minus matched control score (%), in percentage points; all models/calibrations share one y-axis scale. Plain bars with no intervals or significance markers.
normalization.undefined: Zero control denominators yield missing values, never clipped; negative recovery is retained.

limitations: Local diagonal activation-weighted reconstruction is a proxy, not a measured block intervention or downstream sensitivity.
Llama/Gemma use BF16 sources; Qwen uses F16. Model sizes, architectures and tokenizers differ. KL ratios compare within-model improvement, not absolute model quality.
KL uses 1020 scored tokens/domain, with different tokenizers; normalized results do not establish statistical significance.
Graphs summarize three fixed calibration choices, not independent repeated trials; benchmark panels have no inferential intervals.
Q8 is a negative control and can ignore imatrix. Small output/benchmark changes at unchanged weights can reflect execution variation.
This report verifies saved aggregate hashes, local CSV provenance, layouts and selected IDs; it does not rerun inference, revalidate individual sample scores or reopen model payloads.
